title: Which Arrears Figure is Taken on a Rider Being Suspended
content:
The figure the rider record shows standing owed and the figure the entries struck give do not always agree on one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders. The basis below settles which is taken.

## The rule

**Where the figure the rider record shows standing owed is not the one the entries struck give and the rider stands at active**, the figure taken is the one those entries give.

**Where the rider stands ended**, the figure taken is what every charge on the account comes to less every payment and every credit on it.

**Otherwise**, the figure taken is the one the rider record shows standing owed.

## The three quantities

**The figure the record shows.** The rider premium standing owed as the rider's own record carries it.

**The figure the entries struck give.** The rider premium charged that is struck, less the money struck against it, less the credits struck, never less than nothing.

**What every entry on the account comes to.** Every charge on the rider premium account less every payment and every credit on it, whatever span would otherwise govern, and never less than nothing.

## Condition and figure

| The rider's standing | The record against the entries struck | The figure taken |
|---|---|---|
| Active | They differ | The one the entries struck give |
| Active | They agree | The one the record shows |
| Ended | Either | Every charge on the account less every payment and every credit on it |
| Any other standing | Either | The one the record shows |

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

A rider record shows 120.00 USD standing owed. The entries struck give 93.80 USD. Every entry on the account comes to 150.00 USD.

- **Standing at active:** the two differ, so the figure taken is the one the entries struck give, 93.80 USD.
- **Standing ended:** the figure taken is 150.00 USD.
- **Standing in its waiting period:** the figure taken is the one the record shows, 120.00 USD.

Where the record showed 93.80 USD and the rider stood at active, the two would agree and the figure taken would be 93.80 USD either way. Every figure is rounded to the nearest cent and is never less than nothing.
